scope: Proposition 18.2 of the manuscript “Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-mixing-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ac6296cc238bae9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 164. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the preceding choices, with probability tending to one there is an intrinsic auxiliary cap potential e ϕp(h) = log Eg exp Ψ(h + √ ∆ g), h ∈ Pp, whose Hessian satisfies (16.2) on the used annulus, with slack. Moreover, for a finite constant C independent of n, sup h∈Ap(σ) ∥∇e ϕp(h) − Pp∇ϕp(h)∥ ≤ C. (18.12) The constant may depend on all the fixed initialization parameters.
